summary: Wilson, running for South Carolina governor, signed a December 2023 letter with thirteen other Republican AGs demanding media outlets sever ties with Gaza-based freelancers accused of Hamas affiliation, and in October 2024 spoke at a 'Gamecocks for Israel' event expressing solidarity with Israel and calling for hostage release. His campaign platform contains no statement on Palestinian justice, Gaza, or U.S. policy toward Israel, so his documented record on the conflict consists of these two pro-Israel actions.
